programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Se izan las velas del Hoppetosse. Efraim Calzaslargas da la orden final de abandonar el puerto. Sin embargo, las lágrimas de Annika y Tommi impulsan a Fifi a tomar una decisión espontánea: se lanza por la borda.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Todo comienza un jueves. Los padres de Annika y Tommi se van de viaje. Poco tiempo después, los niños también emprenden un viaje con Pippi a la tierra de Taka-Tuka. Allí, unos piratas mantienen prisionero al padre de Pippi, el capitán Efraim Calzaslargas.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Pippi, Annika y Tommi pasan una noche increíble en una isla. Cuando el pirata Óscar, el Tuerto, pasa en su barco, Pippi saca su caja de trucos y roba su nave pirata.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Los piratas se aterrorizaron al enterarse de la llegada de Pippi. Sin embargo, ella logró sorprender a su padre y finalmente llevarle una comida decente.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Pippi logra liberar a su padre de la fortaleza. Ahora comienza la verdadera aventura: todos intentarán encontrar el fabuloso tesoro de la isla Taka-Tuka en una emocionante carrera.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Annika y Tommi están hartos: la constante atención de su madre es insoportable. Ahora, además, tienen que arrancar malas hierbas en un precioso y caluroso día de verano. ¡Ya basta! Se van a casa de Pippi y comienza su próxima aventura.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Annika demuestra que las cosas no suelen ocurrir por casualidad: ahuyenta al vendedor ambulante Konrad insistiendo constantemente en que se lave los oídos. El parecido con su madre es innegable.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Los niños van de casa en casa y sus canciones son bien recibidas. Su viaje hacia la libertad continúa en tren. Pippi defiende a un niño de un toro. El padre del niño le regala un coche destrozado como muestra de gratitud.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: El mágico coche volador de Pippi se está desintegrando poco a poco. La niña, dotada de dones excepcionales, se prepara para un aterrizaje de emergencia. A orillas de un lago, Annika vuelve a verse invadida por una compulsión a la limpieza.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Los hermanos Tommi y Annika llevan una vida tranquila. Junto a la casa de sus padres se encuentra la deshabitada Villa Kunterbunt. Un buen día aparece una niña pelirroja: Pippi Calzaslargas.
programme.sub-title: Pippi se instala en Villa Kunterbunt

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Pippi causa sensación con un frenesí de compras. Con una moneda de oro compra casi toda la tienda de caramelos, lo que hace la mayor alegría a los niños del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Pippi se alegra porque ha sido invitada a tomar café en casa de la madre de sus dos amigos. Se siente muy honrada y empieza enseguida a aprender buenos modales con el tío pequeño y el señor Nilson.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Pippi va a buscar a Annika y Tommi para una escapada. Ella observa cómo el dueño de la casa, en el jardín, intenta enseñar a sus hijos a dar en el blanco con los dardos. El pobre hombre se esfuerza en vano. En ese momento llega Pippi.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Pippi celebra su cumpleaños: durante el día lo festeja con entusiasmo y canta canciones de cumpleaños. Por la noche, les ofrece regalos a sus invitados, para su gran sorpresa.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Annita y Tommi se dirigieron entusiasmados a la Villa Kunterbunt: querían hablar con Pippi sobre la plaza Rummelplatz que acababan de construir en su pequeño pueblo.
programme.sub-title: Pippi va al parque de atracciones

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Pippi está encantada con la primera nevada, pero algo la preocupa. Piensa que es muy injusto no tener vacaciones como Tommi y Annika. Así que decide ir al colegio para poder tener vacaciones escolares.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Se acerca la Navidad. La tía Bruselius tiene la brillante idea de dejar a Pippi en el orfanato, al menos para la Nochebuena. Pero la señorita Calzaslargas no se plantea ni por un instante renunciar a su libertad, ni por un segundo.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Una nueva palabra surge en la mente de Pippi, y su sonido la fascina por completo: «spunk». Se deshace en su boca mejor que un pastel de desayuno. Pero no sabe qué significa «spunk». Así que emprende la búsqueda de la misteriosa criatura.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Los dos delincuentes, Donner-Carl y Blom, roban la maleta de Pippi, que contiene su oro, de la villa Kunterbunt. Pippi no se da cuenta de nada porque en ese momento está en el ático buscando el antiguo balón de su padre.

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: A Annika y Tommi les esperan tiempos difíciles. Sus padres se van de viaje y le piden específicamente a la tía Bruselius que los cuide.
programme.sub-title: Pippi va a una isla solitaria

programme.title: Pippi Calzaslargas
programme.desc: Efraim Calzaslargas visita a su hija Pippi. Quiere llevarlas a la isla de Kureduten, en el mar del sur, donde es venerado como rey. Fifi está encantada de ser princesa de Kureduten, pero Annika y Tommi están muy tristes.
programme.sub-title: Pippi se marcha de Villa Kanterbunt

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: Phryne decide perfeccionar su “baile de los abanicos” para poder introducirse de forma secreta en el club de caballeros de la célebre Madam Lyon.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: Phryne hace de anfitriona de unos soldados fantasmales y unos espiritistas exóticos.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: La jovialidad del famoso paseo marítimo de St. Kilda se ve alterada por la violencia de las luchas entre las bandas y la policía que intenta controlarlas.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: Cuando Phryne aparece en el salón de Madame Fleuri para que le tomen medidas, se ve envuelta inesperadamente en el medio de la escena de un crimen.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: En el rápido mundo de un taller mecánico en el que todas son mujeres, la mecánica de Phryne, Ailsa, se prepara para una marcha anual organizada por la Asociación Victoriana del Automóvil.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: Cuando el cuerpo sin vida del profesor Katz aparece en lugar de otro cadáver en la clase de anatomía de la doctora Mac, esta exige que Phryne y Jack, ahora separados, trabajen juntos para ella.
programme.sub-title: La sangre de Juana la Loca

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: Al ser el productor de la película un viejo conocido de Phryne, esta se ve obligada a involucrarse cuando el actor protagonista es asesinado en el escenario.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: Cuando Phryne llega a un viñedo idílico en el campo para investigar una muerte sospechosa del pasado, se encuentra en mitad del Festival del Vino anual y con el asesinato aún fresco de su propio “cliente”.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: Hay una nueva radio en la casa de los Fisher, pero también hay un asesinato en las ondas cuando el programa preferido de Dot se ve interrumpido por pánico en directo.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher
programme.desc: El mundo gótico de Magdalene Laundries, un hogar de transición para chicas embarazadas y descarriadas dirigido por monjas católicas, es el telón de fondo para la trágica muerte de un adolescente huido.

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher

programme.title: Los misteriosos asesinatos de Miss Fisher

programme.title: El comisario: Cosas a las que uno nunca se acostumbra
programme.desc: Un niño es ingresado en un hospital con señales de haber sido violado. La policía se hace cargo del caso y empieza a investigar el círculo más cercano al niño: su familia. Sin embargo no encuentran nada.
programme.sub-title: Cosas a las que uno nunca se acostumbra

programme.title: Águila Roja

programme.title: El comisario: Tabú
programme.desc: Un detective muere apaleado en las puertas de un bar de copas donde se encontraba siguiendo a un adolescente al que sus padres querían vigila. Los agentes de EL comisario Castillo tendrán que hacerse cargo del caso.

programme.title: El comisario: Su único hijo
programme.desc: La comisaría de San Fernando coge al nuevo agente de policía Pau Montaner, un chico de Barcelona formal, metódico, introvertido y riguroso. Su llegada se producirá en el peor momento para Vanesa, que sigue sumida en una depresión.

programme.title: El comisario: Ondas de poder alfa
programme.desc: El drogadicto que se quedó con la pistola y la placa de Pope se hará pasar por el policía para cometer varios delitos. Con el agente todavía desaparecido, los de Asuntos Internos se verán obligados a intervenir en el caso.

programme.title: El comisario: Amantes y vecinos
programme.desc: El aparente suicidio de un hombre que habita en un edificio ruinoso desvelará una trama de pasiones secretas entre los propios vecinos del inmueble, que provocará que nuevas víctimas mortales según vaya avanzando la investigación.

programme.title: El comisario: Historia de un policía
programme.desc: Gerardo encuentra por fin a Pope en el bar donde suele pasar las horas y lo hace gracias a la investigación que ha abierto por su cuenta al margen de los agentes del Departamento de Asuntos Internos del cuerpo.

programme.title: El comisario: Balones fuera
programme.desc: El portero de un club de Segunda División aparece colgado del larguero de su portería. La relación entre el futbolista y una joven prostituta hará dudar a los agentes de que se trate de un simple suicidio, como parece a priori.

programme.desc: El portero de un club de Segunda División aparece colgado del larguero de su portería. La relación entre el futbolista y una joven prostituta hará dudar a los agentes de que se trate de un simple suicidio, como parece a priori.

programme.title: El comisario: El susurro de la sangre
programme.desc: Eva se verá contra las cuerdas cuando, tras el asesinato de una mujer a manos del falso vampiro, anuncia ante toda la prensa que han detenido al presunto autor de los ataques.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Ana es una joven que trabaja como bailarina en un local de striptease, el club Chicago. Cansada de intentar, sin exito, triunfar como actriz, acude a una agencia de trabajo temporal para conseguir un nuevo empleo.

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: El Fogar de Breogán, restaurante gallego viral en TikTok, es visitado para comprobar si su fama está justificada probando varios platos, incluido su famoso menú de churrasco gallego.
programme.sub-title: El pueblo gallego que conquista TikTok

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: Visita al restaurante Zazpi STM en el Museo San Telmo de Donosti, donde el chef Paul rescata recetas del legendario Zuberoa. Una joya imprescindible en la Parte Vieja de San Sebastián.
programme.sub-title: El Restaurante Secreto de San Sebastián

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo y Aitor visitan La Sidre, un asador vasco en Vitoria-Gasteiz, donde prueban el menú sidrería por 56€ sin IVA y comparten sus impresiones.

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: Visita al restaurante Cataria, en el hotel Iberostars de Sancti Petri, especializado en brasas. Menú degustación de 145€ con 10 pases que dejó sensaciones agridulces.
programme.sub-title: El restaurante de lujo donde todo salió mal

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo visita la Sidrería La Parrilla en Ribadesella, Asturias, recomendada por un seguidor. Prueba marisco y pescado fresco de la lonja local, acompañados de sidra.
programme.sub-title: La Sidrería que Lo Cambió Todo

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: Visita al restaurante viral La Peña en Lorca con Xuso Jones. Por 50€, disfrutan de mariscos, carne, ensalada, postre y café en rondas abundantes servidas con pala.

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo visita el Rebo Bar de Eve, "La Tortillera", en Sant Boi. Prueban tortillas variadas, croquetas, bravas, el mejor bocadillo de Cataluña y tarta de queso.

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: El Mesón de los 20 Platos en Zaragoza ofrece un menú de 28 platos por 29€ que nadie ha terminado jamás. Pablo lo prueba y nos da su veredicto.

programme.title: Cenando con Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo visita a Walter y Ana, protagonistas de un polémico episodio de Pesadilla en la Cocina, en su nuevo negocio en Berga. Prueban sus platos y revelan secretos del programa.

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: In this film noir episode, narrated by Linny, the Wonder Pets must help a Fox whose diamond-studded collar has mysteriously disappeared.
programme.sub-title: Save the Vixen!/Teach an Old Dog New Tricks!

programme.title: Wonder Pets

programme.sub-title: Back to Kalamazoo!/Bee and Slug Underground!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: Ming-Ming flies through the shrink machine the wrong way and becomes enormous! In this swinging Andrews Sisters-style show, the Wonder Pets get a phone call from Little Bo Peep, who's lost her three singing Sheep.
programme.sub-title: The Bigger the Better!/Help Little Bo Peep!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: The Wonder Pets travel to Cape Cod to help a Lobster in a lobster trap free himself before the trap is raised. Floppy the Elephant comes to the classroom for a sleepover. But when Floppy gets homesick, the team must help him feel at home.
programme.sub-title: Save the Rock Lobster!/Help the Houseguest!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: The Wonder Pets travel to the Florida Everglades to reunite a pair of quarreling Lovebugs on Valentine's Day./The Wonder Pets get a call from Manchester, England where a Skunk Rocker can't find a band to play with him.
programme.sub-title: Save the Lovebugs!/Save the Skunk Rocker!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Ni Hao, Halloween: Trick or treat, it's Halloween! Kai-lan and her friends dress up to go trick or treating with Ye-Ye. Kai-lan is a dinosaur, Tolee's a panda, Hoho's the Monkey King, and Rintoo is his favorite – a dragon!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Beach Day: Kai-lan is excited because today she's going to the beach with Ye-Ye and her friends, to play in the sand, fly kites, and go in the water!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Roller Rintoo: Kai-lan and her friends are off to a roller rink to go skating! But when Rintoo won't put on his roller skates, Kai-lan thinks something is wrong. It turns out that Rintoo is scared of roller skating.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Rain or Shine: Kai-lan and her friends are planning a big day of playing outdoors, when suddenly it starts to rain! Kai-lan happily finds a way to play in the rain, but Rintoo, Tolee and Hoho are very upset because of the rain.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Ni Hao Kai-lan: Kai-lan and her friends wake up early today because...there's a CARNIVAL in the backyard with game booths, prizes and rides!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Lulu Day: Today, Kai-lan is having a playdate with her best girl friend, Lu-lu the rhino! Kai-lan is ready with all sorts of games and things to play with Lu-lu. But Lu-lu wants to play with DIFFERENT things than Kai-lan.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Sports Day: Kai-lan LOVES dinosaurs, and today she's made up a whole bunch of Olympic-style Dinosaur Games to play with her friends!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan gets a phone call from her favorite great aunt , Gu-nai-nai, in China, inviting us to come to China and meet a baby panda! Ye-Ye, Kai-lan, and her friends take an airplane to China to meet the baby.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet été, l'heure n'est pas à la détente mais à la compétition. Jimmy et ses amis handicapés mettent tout en oeuvre pour être les champions du camp de vacances.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman rêve de devenir pilote de Nascar et est prêt à tout pour y parvenir. Comme il est persuadé qu'il faut être pauvre et stupide pour exceller dans cette discipline, il va tenter de se débarrasser de tout son argent et de ses neurones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pour lutter contre l'invasion des habitants de New Jersey, la ville de South Park se mobilise et en vient à faire appel à Oussama Ben Laden.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: À la demande de Wendy Testaburger, Stan accepte de ranger son casier avec l'aide d'un groupe de 'spécialistes'.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon et ses amis sont disposés à aider les victimes de la marée noire provoquée par BP suite à un accident de forage dans le Golfe du Mexique.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Emmenés par Mystérion, les super-héros doivent résoudre la crise du Golfe et arrêter Cthulhu. Mais le Coon a d'autres idées en tête.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon se révèle être plus infâme encore que le Seigneur maléfique Cthulhu! Alors que le Coon punit ses anciens amis, Kenny tente de vivre avec le fardeau que représente son super-pouvoir.
programme.sub-title: Le Coon contre le Coon et sa bande

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: C'est la pagaille dans la vie de Stan, à la maison comme à l'école, à cause de l'obsession de Randy pour les chaînes culinaires. Et cela affecte même Sharon qui, se sentant délaissée, décide de faire du sport.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle n'ayant pas lu les petites lettres de son contrat, il est kidnappé par Apple, qui a de grands projets pour lui. Il appartient aux garçons de le sauver.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après que l'on se soit moqué de l'Allemagne lors des récompenses pour la comédie, les Allemands construisent une machine à rires: Funnybot. Cependant, ses projets pour l'humanité ne sont pas très réjouissantes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La princesse canadienne est kidnappée pendant sa cérémonie de mariage, Ike est convoqué au Canada pour aider à la retrouver. Qui peut bien être l'auteur d'un tel crime?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après un incident embarrassant impliquant les parties des garçons, Cartman est envoyé en thérapie de 'gestion de la colère' et Randy fait de son mieux pour gérer les retombées.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Kyle découvre que Cartman se porte bénévole pour les bébés accros au crack dans l'hôpital de la ville, il commence à douter. Que fait Slash (des Guns n' Roses) dans tout ça?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Butters est pris dans une guerre de territoire asiatique, ses parents découvrent qu'il a plusieurs personnalités et décident que la seule solution est de lui administrer des médicaments.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pour son anniversaire, Stan reçoit en cadeau un CD de 'tween wave' mais ses parents lui interdisent d'écouter cette 'merde'. Stan se surprend à être d'accord avec eux, mais ses amis n'en sont pas impressionnés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan continue d'avoir sa crise existentielle alors que Cartman intègre le monde du hamburger avec un ingrédient super spécial, top secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un jeu de 'garde-frontières' termine mal et Butters finit par faire revivre la fierté mexicaine, mais Cartman n'est pas prêt à laisser le jeu se terminer ainsi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque l'école primaire de South Park est victime d'un site internet dévoilant les secrets de tous, c'est l'hécatombe. Qui sauvera la situation? Cartman ou Gerbil King Lemmiwinks?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Randy apprend le secret qui se cache derrière la comédie musicale, il ne peut s'empêcher d'y emmener Sharon. Andrew Lloyd-Webber et Elton John le supplient de ne pas révéler leur secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après la visite à l'école d'un intervenant venu expliquer les affres du harcèlement, Stan décide de réaliser un clip vidéo (sous forme de lip dub) pour sensibiliser le reste du monde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, Stan, Kyle et Kenny partent en excursion dans les Rocheuses du Colorado pour y découvrir la tyrolienne. Le voyage des enfants va rapidement virer au cauchemar.
programme.sub-title: Je n'aurais jamais dû faire de la tyrolienne

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'arrivée d'une nouvelle camarade de classe de couleur va donner envie à Cartman de mettre en application ses conceptions personnelles sur l'amour et les races, en tentant de la faire tomber amoureuse du petit Token Black.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy Marsh change radicalement les règles du football à l'école élémentaire de South Park. Sa nouvelle version du jeu devient le sport le plus populaire du pays.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman prend conscience de son poids et décide de conduire un scooter pour handicapé. Kyle constate que de plus en plus de personnes mènent sans honte ce genre de vie autour de lui. C'est alors que Cartman se découvre une rivale.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle pense que sa mère a une liaison avec un livreur UPS. Lorsque la méfiance du public tombe sur lui, la livraison de colis dans le quartier est menacée, et Eric Cartman achète un système de sécurité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Quand Butters sort de l'école, ses parents se rendent compte qu'il est temps de lui dire pourquoi il n'est pas comme tous les autres enfants. Il doit se rendre dans un lieu étrange pour apprendre les voies de son peuple.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de Randy pour Halloween empêchent Stan de pouvoir aller à la chasse aux bonbons avec ses amis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ayant appris que Jésus s'était dopé pour accomplir ses miracles, le monde se sent perdu et trahi. Les garçons, joints par le reste de la nation, retirent les bracelets jaunes symbolisant leur ancienne idole.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman cache un terrible secret dans sa chambre à coucher qui pourrait changer les élections présidentielles 2012 aux États-unis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle est en colère contre Cartman qui a pris la mauvaise habitude de parler au téléphone avec le haut-parleur, et l'accuse de se mêler de sa vie privée. Cartman informe alors les autres élèves de l'école que le gouvernement les espionne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Peter Mullen informe ses camarades de classe que ses parents (entre autres !) regardent 'Informative Murder Porn', une émission susceptible de les inciter à s'entretuer. Les enfants décident donc de bloquer les chaines.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a appris que George Zimmerman n'était pas coupable du meurtre de Trayvon Martin, un jeune noir dans un quartier résidentiel aux Etats-Unis, Cartman est perturbé par une personne qu'il considère comme une menace pour l'humanité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Henrietta, une des gothiques de l'école, est envoyée dans un camp pour enfants en difficulté. Elle en revient transformée en emo. En l'apercevant, les autres gothiques vont paniquer et demander de l'aide aux vampires.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook tells Franky and Robin the secret to slaying zombies, and Gecko Moria reveals the terrifying monster that will be the recipient of Luffy's shadow!
programme.sub-title: THE WARRIOR KNOWN AS THE "DEVIL"!! THE MOMENT OF OARS' REVIVAL

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's shadow is forced into the body of a monster, Usopp and Chopper get incinerated, and Nami is kidnapped by a zombie who wants to make her his wife!
programme.sub-title: AWAKENING AFTER 500 YEARS!! OARS OPENS HIS EYES!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Gecko Moria's minions struggle with the burden of feeding a giant zombie brought to life by Luffy's shadow. Meanwhile, Brook flashes back to a battle that almost cost him his beloved afro!
programme.sub-title: A BELIEF WORTH BEGGING TO LIVE FOR!! BROOK DEFENDS HIS AFRO

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The freshly-revived trio of Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji discover that their shadows are missing, and Franky relates Brook's story about a promise he made to a very special whale!
programme.sub-title: A MAN'S PROMISE NEVER DIES!! TO THE FRIEND WAITING UNDER THE DISTANT SKY

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats flash back to the heartbreaking story of Laboon the abandoned whale, and Brook's battle with the zombie samurai reveals the reason behind his intense afro love!
programme.sub-title: I SWEAR TO GO SEE HIM!! BROOK AND THE CAPE OF PROMISE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy sets out to regain his shadow and convince Brook to join the crew. Meanwhile, Sanji races to stop Nami's zombie wedding before it's too late!
programme.sub-title: FOOD, NAMI AND SHADOWS!! LUFFY'S ENRAGED COUNTERATTACK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp's naturally negative personality makes him the only Straw Hat who stands a chance against Perona's depressing army of ghosts, and Chopper prepares to do battle against his hero, Dr. Hogback!
programme.sub-title: USOPP'S THE STRONGEST? LEAVE ANYTHING NEGATIVE TO HIM

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When Brook is overmatched by the zombie samurai, Zoro steps in to help the skeleton get his shadow back. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares for a battle with Gecko Moria, and Sanji interrupts an undead wedding!
programme.sub-title: THE GENERAL ZOMBIES ARE DOWN IN A FLASH!! OARS FEELS LIKE AN ADVENTURE!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Despite his furious attempts, Luffy struggles to land a blow against Gecko Moria, but Sanji fares much better in his passionate attempt to defeat Nami's beastly abductor!
programme.sub-title: BLAZING KNIGHT SANJI!! KICK DOWN THE FAKE WEDDING

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible, Luffy finally manages to land a blow in his battle with Gecko Moria, and Usopp uses fire to ward off a zombie bear!
programme.sub-title: A CLEAR-CLEAR HISTORY? SANJI'S STOLEN DREAM

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After getting the stuffing beat out of him by a zombie teddy bear, Usopp summons his sharp-shooting alter ego to help him discover the secret to defeating Perona!
programme.sub-title: SAVE ME, HERO!! MY ENEMY IS THE IMMORTAL PRINCESS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp reaches deep into his devious bag of tricks to even the odds in his battle with Perona. Meanwhile, Luffy can't lay a finger on Gecko Moria, and a zombie is less than gentlemanly in his battle with Robin!
programme.sub-title: PERONA IS TERRIFIED!! USOPP AND UNTRUTHFUL SHARE THE SAME "U"

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Franky and Brook watch in awe, Zorro and the zombie samurai wage a sword-slinging battle the likes of which the world has never seen before!
programme.sub-title: SLASHES DANCING ON THE ROOFTOP!! SHOWDOWN: ZORO VS. RYUMA

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper can no longer contain his fury over Dr. Hogback's evil treatment of his zombie slaves. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares to face the zombie who's wearing his shadow!
programme.sub-title: CHOPPER IS FURIOUS!! HOGBACK'S EVIL MEDICAL PRACTICES

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Moria's mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy's shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji's eyes!
programme.sub-title: OARS ROARS! COME OUT, STRAW HAT CREW

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy's got his sights set on Moria, but he'd better hurry if he wants to save his crew!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY IS THE ENEMY! THE ULTIMATE ZOMBIE VS. THE STRAW HAT CREW

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami wakes up just in time to find out she's about to marry a zombie, but the special occasion is interrupted by very jealous warthog!
programme.sub-title: YOU'RE GOING DOWN, ABSALOM!! NAMI'S LIGHTNING ATTACK OF FRIENDSHIP!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami attempts to track down some missing treasure, Brook searches the kitchen for a mystery ingredient, and a heroic team effort topples Oars!
programme.sub-title: KNOCK HIM DOWN!! SPECIAL ATTACK: STRAW HAT DOCKING?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami has a horrifying run in with Bartholomew Kuma, Perona becomes the latest lady to vanish, and Chopper, Franky, and Usopp team up to strike a blow against Oars!
programme.sub-title: THE SILENT ASSAULT!! THE MYSTERIOUS VISTOR, "TYRANT" KUMA

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kuma has an upsetting message for Moria, Luffy loses track of his intended target, and Zoro attempts to harness the power of a new sword during his battle with Oars!
programme.sub-title: OARS + MORIA / THE MOST HEINOUS COMBINATION OF BRAINS AND BRAWN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook arrives with the salt needed to stop Oars, but the monster shows off some special new abilities. Deep in the forest, Luffy makes some new friends who help him power up!
programme.sub-title: THE SECRET PLAN TO TURN THE TABLES / NIGHTMARE LUFFY MAKES HIS APPEARANCE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook joins the fight as the Straw Hats valiantly try to hold off Oars and Moria until Luffy returns. Unfortunately, even their combined powers are no match for these evil enemies!
programme.sub-title: THE STRAW HAT CREW GETS WIPED OUT / THE SHADOW-SHADOW'S POWERS IN FULL SWING

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Oars and Moria ruthlessly pummel the badly beaten Straw Hats. The situation looks bleak until the shocking arrival of Nightmare Luffy!
programme.sub-title: THE INCREDIBLE BATTLE STARTS! LUFFY VS. LUFFY

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After Luffy's shadow power disappears, he'll need help from rest of the Straw Hats to land a devastating finishing blow in his battle against Oars.
programme.sub-title: THE END OF THE BATTLE IS NIGH! POUND IN THE FINISHING MOVE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Moria gobbles up every shadow in sight to power up for a final showdown with Luffy. Can the Straw Hats save the day before the dawn reduces them all to ashes!?
programme.sub-title: OUR BODIES VANISH! THE MORNING SUN SHINES ON THE NIGHTMARISH ISLAND!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The battle between Luffy and Moria reaches its epic end, and the gargantuan shadow of the towering brute known as Kuma causes a panic on the island!
programme.sub-title: NOT OUT OF DANGER YET! ORDERS TO ANNIHILATE THE STRAW HAT CREW

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kuma is ordered by the World Government to obliterate every living being on the island, but the Straw Hats – battered as they may be – refuse to go down without a fight!
programme.sub-title: IT REPELS EVERYTHING / KUMA'S PAW-PAW POWER

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A heated confrontation occurs between Zoro and Sanji as they argue over who will sacrifice themselves to save Luffy, but Kuma's final attack may be worse than death.
programme.sub-title: THE PAIN OF MY CREWMATES IS MY PAIN / ZORO'S DESPERATE FIGHT

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji learns the truth about Zoro's amazing sacrifice, and Brook is overjoyed to learn that Laboon is still alive and doing fine!
programme.sub-title: THE PROMISE FROM A DISTANT DAY / THE PIRATES' SONG AND A SMALL WHALE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A flashback reveals the story of how Laboon and Brook became friends – and the promise that was made at the hour of their sorrowful parting of the ways.
programme.sub-title: BROOK'S PAST / A SAD FAREWELL WITH HIS CHEERFUL COMRADE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook remembers the painful loss of his beloved captain, the tragic end to his musical pirate crew, and his lonely days as a skeleton adrift in the shadows.
programme.sub-title: BINK'S BREW / THE SONG THAT CONNECTS THE PAST WITH THE PRESENT

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook officially signs on as the newest member of the Straw Hats, and Luffy learns that his brother Ace may be in some serious trouble.
programme.sub-title: A NEW CREWMATE! THE MUSICIAN, HUMMING BROOK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats encounter two young girls who are looking for their father, and Luffy has another run in with the devious Captain Foxy!
programme.sub-title: THE SLOW-SLOW MENACE / "SILVER FOX" FOXY RETURNS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook struggles to adjust to life among living after so many years alone in the darkness. Can the Straw Hats survive his chaotic attempts to fit in?
programme.sub-title: BROOK'S GREAT STRUGGLE / IS THE PATH TO BECOMING A TRUE COMRADE RIGOROUS?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Lost City: Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Meet Diego!: Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Save The Puppies: Woof! Woof! Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies." A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages. To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ¡Por Favor!: Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou - a cute and cuddly forest creature - who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Dino: Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island. It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs. Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' Special Day: Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots most favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: To The South Pole: Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin! It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Pingüino all the way back home to the South Pole.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boot's Cuddly Dinosaur: It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Super Silly Fiesta: Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats and even silly dancing.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Fix-It Machine: Uh oh! Boots has a hole - un hoyo - in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baseball Boots: Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs - from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind, and snow!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's cousin Diego protects and defends all the animals in the rainforest. But in order to save a Baby Condor, Diego winds up trapped himself. And now he needs OUR help! ¡No te preocupes, Diego!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh no! Baby Jaguar's best friend, Baby Bear, is stuck on a ledge atop Bear Mountain - and the ledge is cracking! With Baby Jaguar leading the way, Dora, Boots, and Diego race to the rescue!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant wall, and all the way to the finish line.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost Baby Fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Arthur

programme.sub-title: Double Tibble Trouble/Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen's not afraid of much, but when she encounters a really creepy howling noise in the woods, she's scared for real. Then, Grandma Thora has a lot of fun stuff, especially her porcelain doll, Clarissa.
programme.sub-title: What Scared Sue Ellen?/Clarissa Is Cracked

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When painfully shy George brings a ventriloquist dummy to school, a popular kid is born! Then, Arthur thinks the best pet to have is a dog, and Francine probably would have agreed--that is, until little Nemo, a cute kitten, came along.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.
programme.sub-title: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur just might make it to Happy Crazy Wow Day at the park--if he and D.W. can work together to clean their rooms! Then, Arthur and the gang realize they are suffering from the January doldrums brought on by an acute lack of holidays.
programme.sub-title: Arthur and D.W. Clean Up/The Long, Dull Winter

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When D.W. discovers that she can get her own library card, she rejoices at the world of books waiting for her. And, is it ever okay to hit someone? Sometimes you just get so mad, you wanna....pow! Right??

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The kids capture a snake and learn that it's possibly poisonous--after it gets lost in Arthur's house! Why is Muffy interviewing for a new best friend? She and Francine are usually inseparable, but lately it seems they have less in common.
programme.sub-title: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Will Buster's friends treat him the same after they learn he has asthma? Prankster have arrived in Elwood City--just in time for the "Scare Your Pants Off" costume party! It's boys vs. girls in what becomes a great big battle of the pranks.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What would happen if Arthur and his friends entered a contest to write stories for their favorite TV show? Then, look out world, D.W. has discovered science! But D.W.'s new-found passion proves that a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A blizzard comes to town, taking out the electricity and sending residents scrambling for supplies. Can neighbors find ways to help each other survive through the storm? Then, the unthinkable is happening...Arthur's teacher is moving in!
programme.sub-title: The Blizzard/The Rat Who Came To Dinner

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What happens when you combine Greek Mythology with D.W.'s imagination? Then, getting two Polly Locket dolls almost ruins Prunella's birthday party. That, and Francine's bad mood--why, she wouldn't even sing the Happy Birthday song!
programme.sub-title: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Does Binky have a favorite pastime? Not until citywide Bug Week, when suddenly all he can think about is butterflies. Then, there's a horrible racket in Elwood City, and it's Francine practicing her singing and drumming for the Talent Show!
programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Wingman/To Beat Or Not To Beat

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Buster insists that he will miss the Father's Day picnic because he has other plans, Arthur is convinced that he's really sad and embarrassed about his parents’ divorce. And Prunella predicts a gift of flashpants, the hot new fashion.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and friends are all faced with seemingly impossible tasks, from fixing a model biplane to babysitting D.W. And, Buster knows he's fun, but he's beginning to feel like he's not particularly good at anything.
programme.sub-title: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's the duel of the century as cellist Yo-Yo Ma faces jazz saxophonist Joshua Redman in the toughest gig of their careers at the Elwood City Library! Then, will Arthur be exposed as a baby show lover?
programme.sub-title: My Music Rules/That's A Baby Show!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Alex Trebek lends his voice as gameshow host Alex Lebek in this episode which poses the age-old riddle--is winning really everything? What if your friends dared you to skip homework--and then double dared you to skip school?
programme.sub-title: Arthur And The Big Riddle/Double Dare

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It’s Lakewood Elementary Parents Open House! How will the kids survive a whole evening of their parents' embarrassing antics? Buster is the only kid in Elwood City who doesn't have a Cybertoy, so he decides to 'borrow' one from the store.
programme.sub-title: Kids Are From Earth, Parents Are From Pluto/Nerves Of Steal

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Why is Buster walking backwards and Muffy not talking? They're trying to set world records of course! Then, Arthur thinks his class trip to the Clark Caves will be really cool--but won't it be dark in there?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: An army of lice has descended on the heads of Lakewood Elementary. Who or what is strong enough to defeat them? What if you could be Arthur for a day? View Arthur's life through his very own eyes for this special episode.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: There’s a mock election in Mr. Ratburn's class, but Muffy takes it seriously. How far will she go to win? Francine can't believe it. She gets in trouble no matter what she does -- thanks to the new nosy next-door neighbor!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster is convinced that Pizza Paula's all-you-can-eat contest is his destiny. But how can he possibly win such an important contest without any sleep? Binky volunteers to look after Francine's cat, Nemo, for the weekend.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mary Moo Cow is cancelled, D.W. is devastated. How can television--or life as she knows it--ever be the same? Buster hasn't yet met Bitzi's new boyfriend, but he fears the worst. What if he is a Mom-stealer?
programme.sub-title: The Last of Mary Moo Cow/Bitzi's Beau

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur has a hard time resisting sweets, and one evening his overindulgence wins him an upset stomach and some 'Grimm' dreams. Arthur and D.W. loved it when Grandpa Dave came to visit--but now he only wants to sleep and play checkers.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen is the champion of the popular Internet game, Virtualgoose.com, but she’s become obsessed! And now the gang has moved onto Best of the Nest. Will any of his friends be willing to forgo their computers for a real, live adventure?
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Gets Her Goose Cooked/Best of The Nest

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's beloved piano teacher is retiring, but she assures him that the new teacher is outstanding--and famous, too! When Buster signs up to sell candy for the band, he figures it's easy money -- who doesn't love chocolate?
programme.sub-title: Arthur Plays The Blues/Buster's Sweet Success

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The latest book about everyone's favorite boy wizard--Henry Skreever--is finally out! Every kid in town is lining up to get it, except Prunella, who's ordered a limited edition from England. Ever wonder what Baby Kate and Pal are thinking?
programme.sub-title: Prunella's Special Edition/The Secret Life Of Dogs & Babies

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy's proud that her dad is the new soccer coach--until he exhausts the team with demanding drills. The try-outs for the Young Person's Orchestra are coming to Lakewood Elementary and everyone agrees that Binky is a shoe-in.
programme.sub-title: Muffy's Soccer Shocker/Brother, Can You Spare A Clarinet?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster is convinced that he's seen real UFO's, and he uses Muffy's fancy new telescope to get the proof. Then, Mr. Sipple from next door is moving away and Arthur wonders--who will be the new neighbors?
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Cried Comet/Arthur and Los Vecinos

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: After visiting The Elwood City Times, Francine decides to start her own paper--The Frensky Star! The tabloid is a success--until all her friends stop speaking to her. Somebody stole D.W.'s backpack!! Who is this fluffy unicorn thief?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: All the kids know that George is smart--so why does he sometimes have trouble reading and writing? Then, D.W. is thrilled to be getting an allowance. At last, she'll be rich and powerful!
programme.sub-title: The Boy With His Head In The Clouds/More!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: While struggling to write a poem for his mom, Binky falls asleep and gets trapped in Verseberg--where it's a crime not to rhyme! And D.W. has lost her voice! For Arthur it's a dream come true--until Mom asks Arthur to take care of D.W.
programme.sub-title: Rhyme For Your Life/For Whom The Bell Tolls

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When the Athlete of the Year Award doesn't go to Francine, she makes no effort to hide her hurt feelings from the recipient. Arthur can't believe his parents are hiring a babysitter--he's 8 years old, and babysitters are b-o-r-i-n-g!

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

programme.title: The Age of Adaline
programme.desc: A woman who has miraculously remained young for nearly 80 years meets a charismatic philanthropist who reawakens her passion for life and romance.

programme.title: Bombshell
programme.desc: The provocative real story of three whip-smart, ambitious, strong women who anchored one of America's most powerful news networks -- becoming headlines themselves when they risked everything to stand up to the man who made them famous.

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Aspiring photographer Therese spots the beautiful, elegant Carol perusing the doll displays in a 1950s Manhattan department store. The two women develop a fast bond that becomes a love with complicated consequences.

programme.title: August: Osage County
programme.desc: A cancer-stricken, pill-popping Oklahoma matriarch (Meryl Streep) lets the full force of her venomous nature hit her daughters and other assorted relatives when they gather at her home in the wake of a family tragedy.

programme.title: Trumbo
programme.desc: In 1947, successful screenwriter Dalton Trumbo (Bryan Cranston) and other Hollywood figures get blacklisted for their political beliefs.

programme.title: Captain Fantastic
programme.desc: Raised in the forest and living off the grid, six children venture into the outside world for the first time when their recently widowed father takes them on a road trip.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: A high-school senior (Mae Whitman) sets out to reinvent herself and revolutionize the student body's social order after learning that a judgmental classmate has given her an embarrassing nickname.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues conversation with Shemida and her sister, Dana, who says Shemida’s 70-plus diagnoses are tearing the family apart. Dr. Phil unites this family in an effort to find answers. Is Shemida really sick, or is she addicted to attention? Part 2
programme.sub-title: Hypochondriac, High Drama, Or Really Sick: Saving Shemida Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Danielle and Nick insist they were great parents, saying Danielle’s sister, Kimberly, “kidnapped” their child. Kimberly says these parents are drug addicts. Dr. Phil is their chance to bring their child home despite currently living in a homeless shelter.
programme.sub-title: Lies, Betrayal, And Custody: It's Been 2 Years Since We've Seen Our Daughter

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Heather & Brian, feuding parents over 15-yr-old son Brandon's death. Hear from Brandon's friends, the last to see him alive and two of the young men make shocking allegations against Heather. How does she respond?
programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil's Big Ultimatum: Will Accused Mother Heather Go To Rehab? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tammy and Paul wed for eight years until their marriage ended. After nine months apart the couple secretly remarried, unbeknownst to their families, who would not approve. Weeks after saying "I do" a second time, the two are having doubts of their own.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lydia says she's living in her dream home with a view reminding her of Italy and of being in love. Daughter Kim calls it an overcrowded and messy mansion and is afraid she'll inherit the mess, plus her sister who lives in the basement! Dr. Phil mediates!
programme.sub-title: Help! I'm Going To Inherit A Messy Mansion, Millions And My Adult Sister

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Leah says mom Dora appears sweet but she's actually a narcissist, hypochondriac, drama queen & liar. Can this mother-daughter find common ground and rebuild? Plus Carrie says mom Paula, 61, has been meeting strangers online having sex. Dr. Phil weighs in.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Money is the number one reason why couples say they get divorced. The country's current financial crisis has resulted in more couples getting buried in a landslide of debt which takes its toll on a marriage. Is your marriage on the rocks because of debt?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Teens are obsessed with love more than ever. Parents are concerned over measures their daughters take to keep a boyfriend. A poll asked teens about extreme behavior, some saying they had sex when the didn't want to. Parents, don't miss these safety steps.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Haley adamantly claims she’s pregnant and about to give birth to Jesus, the Son of God. Dr. Travis Stork reveals the result of Haley’s ultrasound. Is she pregnant and giving birth in two weeks? How will Haley handle the truth if she isn’t pregnant? Part 2
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Believes She's Pregnant With Jesus: What Will The Ultrasound Show Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues discussions with Tommy, ex-wife, Julia & new husband, Codey, over the deaths of 19-month-old Darby & 4-year-old Kiera. Dr. Phil enlists forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the autopsy reports. Polygraph tests are offered.
programme.sub-title: Parents Accused Of Murder: Will Julia and Codey Agree To Take The Polygraph Test? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pageant mom Lori & daugther Alaska, 9, made news bleaching the girl's teeth & dyeing her eyelashes. Alaska's pic posted on TheDirty.com, with a man's claim he performed a sexual act while looking at the photo. Plus, Brittany, 21, had sex with a 14-yr-old.
programme.sub-title: Pageant Mom: Did She Put Her Daughter In Danger?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 21 years, Paula is considering divorcing husband, Jeremy, saying he's "clueless, absent & non-verbal." Jeremy says it's Paula--controlling & a grudge-holder. Find out Jeremy's mistake. Dr. Phil and Robin share the secret to their 45-year marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: David says he's in love with "Maria", a Christian woman from Texas with a $10 million inheritance. Even though they've never met, he's paid $25,000 to their lawyer to assist her in receiving her inheritance. Dr. Phil investigates "Maria": real or catfish?
programme.sub-title: Is "Maria" Real? A Big Surprise For David Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sandra and ex-husband Joey admit they’re in a bitter custody battle. Sandra and Joey’s mudslinging has frightening accusations, but are they telling the truth? See what happens when these parents are offered polygraph and drug tests. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Bitter Custody Battle: Claims Of Poison In Ice Cream, A Child Wrapped In A Garbage Bag And Inappropriate Touching: What Will The Polygraph Reveal Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father pleads for help regarding his missing daughter. Gabby Petito, 22, set off on a van trip with her fiancé, but two months later he returned alone. Police revealed the couple had an incident--caught on camera. Gabby's dad is determined to find her.
programme.sub-title: Missing "Van Life" Woman's Father Speaks Out: The Dr. Phil Interview Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 2011, Morgan, 20, was found dead, a suspected overdose with a later ruling of death by suicide. Parents Toni & Steve believe something more sinister: she was stalked, tormented & killed by Brooke, 18, who joins the show with her dad, Jim.
programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil Mystery: Was Morgan Murdered By Stalkers?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Courtney claims her former friend Amie has lied about being pregnant three times and losing five babies total. To uncover the truth, Dr. Phil producers spoke with the county coroner, the hospital, and tracked down one of the supposed fathers-to-be. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accused Of Faking Multiple Pregnancies And Baby Deaths: Is She Scamming Men Or A Victim Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil digs into a heartbreaking story of a father's search for his missing daughter, then the loss of his grandchildren taken away by the man who may be guilty of their mother's disappearance. Don't miss this chilling tale that spans three generations.

programme.title: Die Verwegenen Sieben
programme.desc: Gene Hackman spielt in diesem eindrucksvollen und actiongeladenen Abenteuer Colonel Jason Rhodes, einen besessenen Mann.

programme.title: The Foot Fist Way
programme.desc: Danny McBride spielt in dieser komödiantischen Meisterleistung Fred Simmons, einen unfassbaren Taekwondo-Meister, der sein Dojo mit eiserner Faust beherrscht.

programme.title: Bat21 - Mitten im Feuer
programme.desc: Nachdem sein Flugzeug hinter feindlichen Linien in Vietnam abgeschossen wurde, stellt Lt. Colonel Hambleton (Gene Hackman) Funkkontakt zum Piloten Bird-Dog (Danny Glover) her, der es zu seiner Mission macht, seinen hilflosen Kameraden zu retten.

programme.title: Krach mit der Kompanie
programme.desc: Ein Militärposten in Kentucky Ende 1944: Vic Puccinelli und Alvin Korwin sind ehemalige Nachtclub-Partner, die vom US-Militär einberufen wurden. Im Trainingscamp des Zweiten Weltkriegs folgt ein Missgeschick dem anderen.

programme.title: Explorers - Ein phantastisches Abenteuer
programme.desc: In ihrem improvisierten Labor nutzen drei Jungen eine unglaubliche Entdeckung und ihren Einfallsreichtum, um ihr eigenes Raumschiff zu bauen und auf eine fantastische interplanetarische Entdeckungsreise aufzubrechen.

programme.title: Der Mann im Mond
programme.desc: Dieser herzerwärmende Film über das Erwachsenwerden zeigt Reese Witherspoon als 14-Jährige, die in den 1950er Jahren ihre ersten schwierigen Erfahrungen in Sachen Liebe macht. Mit Sam Waterston und Tess Harper in Nebenrollen.

programme.title: Freiwurf
programme.desc: Norman Dale (Gene Hackman) ist ein abgehalfterter Trainer, dessen letzte Chance ein chancenloses Team ist. Erst unwillkommen, überzeugt Dales grenzenlose Leidenschaft für den Sport die Mannschaft, während er versucht, sie an die Spitze zu bringen!

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Melissa Rycroft schaut sich die erste Probe an, um Kandidatinnen für ihr Mentor-Programm zu finden. Brittany Perry-Russell rüttelt die Kandidatinnen mit ihrer Choreo wach. Mit Melissa Rycroft und Brittany Perry-Russell.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Die Kandidatinnen lernen neue Techniken, um ihre Kicks zu verbessern. Die schnelle Choreo von Evan Miller bereitet einer Kandidatin echte Probleme. Mit Melissa Page und Evan Miller.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Denise DiCharry will mit ihrer anspruchsvollen Choreo herausfinden, wer schnell mithalten kann. Kelli lernt die Neuen während der Anprobe besser kennen. Führt ein unpassender Social-Media-Post zum Rauswurf einer Kandidatin?

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Judy übt mit den Kandidatinnen den Einlauf, und die müssen zum ersten Mal Jump Splits machen. Aber nicht alle bekommen sie einwandfrei hin. Bei einer Probe der Neuen werden Schwächen sichtbar.

programme.title: Faking It: Himmelhoch jauchzend, zu Tode betrübt
programme.desc: Liam begeht einen Beziehungs-Fauxpas. Shane und Amy nehmen Lauren widerwillig zu einer Undergroundparty mit.

programme.title: Faking It: Große Erwartungen
programme.desc: Am Samstagabend hat jeder ein Date.

programme.title: Faking It: Zen und die Kunst des Schönseins
programme.desc: Lauren nimmt an einer Misswahl teil, und auch Amy will beweisen, dass sie das Zeug zur Schönheitskönigin hat. Karma will ihren Eltern bei einem Essen mit Liam sagen, dass sie hetero ist. Shane lernt den Vater seines neuen Freundes kennen.
programme.sub-title: Zen und die Kunst des Schönseins

programme.title: Faking It: Mieses Karma
programme.desc: Amy, Karma und Liam müssen sich miteinander und mit einem sozialen Experiment in der Schule auseinandersetzen. Shane und Lauren plagt die Eifersucht, denn sie sind sich ihrer Partner nicht sicher.

programme.title: Faking It: Erwischt
programme.desc: Amy und Karma haben einen Riesenstreit. Liam erhält vielversprechende Neuigkeiten, was seine Zukunft anbetrifft. Lauren merkt, dass in ihrer Beziehung nicht alles so ist, wie es scheint, und Shane tut alles, um sein Ziel zu erreichen.

programme.title: Faking It: Nackte Tatsachen
programme.desc: Der neue Schulleiter greift in Hester hart durch, also beginnt Shane eine Revolte. Amy hat den Verdacht, dass Karma ihr etwas verheimlicht.

programme.title: Faking It: Das Monokel
programme.desc: Shane und Amy helfen Lauren, sich an Theo zu rächen. Karma und Reagan müssen zusammenarbeiten.

programme.title: Faking It: Zukunftspläne
programme.desc: Nach dem College-Informationstag stellt Amy ihre Zukunft infrage, und Liam denkt, dass er seinen richtigen Vater gefunden hat.

programme.title: Faking It: Der große Kampf
programme.desc: Lauren und Amy glauben, dass entweder ihr Vater oder ihre Mutter eine Affäre hat. // Karma und Shane machen sich Sorgen um ihre Beziehungen.

programme.title: Faking It: Wendepunkt
programme.desc: Beim Nachsitzen kommt es zwischen den Jugendlichen zu Spannungen.

programme.title: Faking It: Schon wieder ein falsches Paar
programme.desc: Karma und Amy tun ein letztes Mal so, als seien sie ein Paar. Shane und Liam versuchen, ihren Liebenskummer zu überwinden.

programme.title: Faking It: Abschlussball-Angst
programme.desc: Der Abschlussball wird zur Pflichtveranstaltung erklärt, und alle versuchen verzweifelt, ein Date zu finden. Shanes Schwester Sasha sorgt für Wirbel.

programme.title: Faking It: Der Abschlussball-Krieg
programme.desc: Karma und Shane versuchen, einander auszustechen. Amy ist überrascht davon, wie sich ihre Gefühle entwickeln.

programme.title: Faking It: Der Sprung ins kalte Wasser
programme.desc: Lauren und Amy sind gezwungen, eine Party zu schmeißen. Und Karma möchte sich neu erfinden.

programme.title: Faking It: Sommerferien
programme.desc: Hesters Zukunft steht auf dem Spiel. Derweil trifft Amy eine wichtige Entscheidung.

programme.title: Faking It: Alles ist gut
programme.desc: Amy kehrt nach Austin zurück und ist überrascht, wie sehr Karma sich verändert hat. Liam ist eifersüchtig auf Shanes neue Freundschaft.

programme.title: Faking It: Fast eine Bar-Mizwa
programme.desc: Amy und Karma sind bereit, sich zu vertragen, aber keine will den ersten Schritt machen. Zita beweist, dass sie Liam unterstützt.

programme.title: Faking It: Karmygeddon
programme.desc: Während Amy und Karma sich bekriegen, sorgen Lauren und Shane für Schadensbegrenzung. Amy und Liam bewahren ein Geheimnis vor Karma.

programme.title: Faking It: Zerbrochenes, kleines Herz
programme.desc: Um nicht an Karma denken zu müssen, beschließt Amy, eine Dokumentation über Lauren zu machen. Karma und Shane gründen eine Band.

programme.title: Faking It: Aller guten Dinge sind drei
programme.desc: Amy und Lauren wollen ihre Eltern wieder zusammenbringen, doch ihr Plan scheitert, als etwas aus Karmas Privatleben ans Licht kommt. Liams Rabbi lädt Liam und Shane zum Abendessen ein.

programme.title: Faking It: Geisterstunde
programme.desc: Auf der Hester-Halloween-Party wollen Amy und Karma die Vergangenheit ruhen lassen, doch sie werden wieder von ihr eingeholt. Shane traut Liam nicht über den Weg.

programme.title: Faking It: Spieleabend
programme.desc: Der Konflikt zwischen Karma und ihrer Rivalin, Amys alter Freundin aus dem Feriencamp, spitzt sich bei einem Spieleabend zu. Liam versucht, sich bei Lauren einzuschmeicheln, und Noahs merkwürdiges Verhalten verwirrt Shane.

programme.title: Faking It: Untitled
programme.desc: Laurens Versuch, die Weihnachtsferien an der Hester Highschool zu retten, bringt Amy in eine schwierige Situation. Karma will Felix helfen, Amy um ein Date zu bitten, und Shane erfährt Noahs Geheimnis.

programme.title: Faking It: Ex-poniert
programme.desc: Amy und Sabrina kommen sich näher, und Karma sucht Beweise dafür, dass Sabrina nicht die Richtige ist. Liam will Lauren verkuppeln, und Shane braucht einen Rat.

programme.title: Faking It: Neue Flammen
programme.desc: Neujahr steht vor der Tür, und Karma ergeift drastische Maßnahmen, um Amy glücklich zu machen. Als eine Person aus Laurens Vergangenheit wieder auftaucht, fühlt sie sich plötzlich verunsichert.

programme.title: Made: Ballkönigin Kristy
programme.desc: Kristy wird zur Ballkönigin gemacht. 'MTV MADE' dokumentiert die innerliche und äußerliche Wandlung einer Person, die sich unbedingt neu erfinden will.

programme.title: Made: Motocross-Fahrerin Kaitlin
programme.desc: Kaitlin wird zur Motocross-Fahrerin gemacht. 'MTV MADE' dokumentiert die innerliche und äußerliche Wandlung einer Person, die sich unbedingt neu erfinden will.

programme.title: Made: Girly Girl- Jamie
programme.desc: Jaimie ist ein typischer Wildfang mit Kapuzenpullover und Energiedrink in der Hand.

programme.title: Made: Basketballspieler - Kenneth
programme.desc: Kenneth ist eine Dancing Diva, doch er ist fest entschlossen, die Anerkennung seines Vaters, der Soldat ist, zu gewinnen, indem er Basketballspieler wird.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: Kylee ist verwirrt darüber, warum ihre Freundin Tonee sie möglicherweise versteckt. Tonee lebt nur etwa vierzig Minuten entfernt, aber es ist, als würden sie in zwei verschiedenen Welten leben. Nach zwei Jahren Beziehung benötigt Kylee Antworten.
